Own the key. Keep the audience.

If a platform can throttle reach, remove content or close the account, it still owns the door. Nostr changes the door: your public key is the identity, your private key signs the proof, clients are replaceable, relays and Blossom servers can be chosen or self-run, and your creator business can move with you.
Where do events and media live?
Can you leave with proof, audience and money path?
Start where control can be lost
Read privacy as ownership, not mood.

Privacy is the right to know what becomes public, what can be encrypted, where files live, who can sign, how money moves and what happens when the platform you used yesterday stops serving you tomorrow.

children: The privacy map by real risk
Start with the power that can hurt you.

Nostr privacy is not one setting. It is the moment you ask who owns the audience, who can sign as you, which app can be replaced, where the data lives, what a lock icon really hides and how freedom survives moderation, law and money.

Start here when you have built an audience on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Reddit, Discord or Patreon and want to understand what still belongs to you if reach, links, payments or the account itself are restricted.
The private key is the account boundary
Before a client, marketplace or creator tool feels exciting, learn what the public key can safely reveal, what the private key can sign and why a Nostr login must never become private-key surrender.
The app is only the door
Use this when a product asks you to connect, publish, authorize or sign. The article separates clients from signers, browser prompts from remote signing and convenience from custody.
Events and media live in different places
Relays carry signed events. Blossom servers carry media bytes. That distinction decides what can be mirrored, what can vanish, what a server can observe and where self-hosting actually helps.
Encryption is not the whole privacy story
Open this before trusting a lock icon. NIP-44, gift wraps, DMs, profile metadata and public relay behavior all protect different things and leave different traces.
Freedom needs visible moderation and legal exit
Free speech, spam defense, web-of-trust, copyright, DSA duties, GDPR rights and direct monetization belong together because a portable account still lives in the real world.
